# Brex — account brief

## Who

Brex is a company whose GitHub org profile lists brex.com ([source](https://github.com/brexhq)). Its homepage describes it as "Brex | Corporate Cards & Spend Management — Brex offers corporate cards and spend management software for startups and enterprises." ([source](https://brex.com/))

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is present in brexhq/brex-mobile ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/eas.json))
- package.json pins react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/package.json))
- The repo has CI workflows ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/tree/main/.github/workflows))
- The org has 27 public repos and 410 followers ([source](https://github.com/brexhq))
- brex-mobile last pushed 2026-08-15 ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile))
- The App Store listing has 28,000 ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141))
- 7 App Store releases shipped in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141))
- The GitHub org description names a regulated category, "financial" ([source](https://github.com/brexhq))
- An open issue reads "expo upgrade to SDK 52 blocked by native module mismatch" ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/issues/87))

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@brexhq-maintainer-1), 260 commits, top contributor to brexhq/brex-mobile ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-1)). Profile lists company "Brex", location "Remote", website https://brex.com, and bio "Mobile engineer at Brex. Maintains the Brex mobile app (Expo / React Native)." ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-1))
- Maintainer Two (@brexhq-maintainer-2), 133 commits, top contributor to brexhq/brex-mobile ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company "Brex", location "New York, NY", website https://brex.com, and bio "React Native developer on the Brex mobile team. EAS builds and releases for the Brex mobile app." ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-2))
- @brexhq-maintainer-3, 58 commits, top contributor to brexhq/brex-mobile ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-3))

## Why now

brex-mobile last pushed 2026-08-15 ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile)) and the App Store listing shows 7 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141)). The repo is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/package.json)) and an open issue says "expo upgrade to SDK 52 blocked by native module mismatch" ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/issues/87)).

## Suggested opener

Maintainer One, your profile says you maintain the Brex mobile app on Expo / React Native ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-1)), and you have 260 commits to brex-mobile ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-1)). Issue 87 in that repo is open with "expo upgrade to SDK 52 blocked by native module mismatch" ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/issues/87)), while the app shipped 7 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141)). How are you sequencing that SDK 52 upgrade against the release cadence in your existing CI workflows ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/tree/main/.github/workflows))?
